name: Encrypted Rune
summary: In Coldridge Valley, Sten Stoutarm gives young rogues a coded rune and calls them into Anvilmar to meet Solm Hargrin.

sections.title: A Message in Code
sections.body: Sten says someone slipped him the etched stone to deliver. He suspects Solm Hargrin sent it. The rune tests whether a novice can keep a confidence, calling them inside without Solm announcing his need for scouts and scoundrels across the courtyard.

sections.title: Under Anvilmar's Rafters
sections.body: Inside Anvilmar, Solm Hargrin welcomes the new rogues to their craft. He offers to teach the maneuvers, strikes, and subtle arts that keep them alive and earn them coin. He also reminds dwarf rogues to look after their displaced gnomish allies, still recovering from Gnomeregan's catastrophic fall.

faq.answer: Solm Hargrin, the rogue trainer in Anvilmar's great hall, writes the rune and has Sten Stoutarm pass it discreetly to promising recruits in the snow.

faq.q: Where do I find Solm Hargrin?
faq.answer: Solm Hargrin is inside Anvilmar's main hall, the stone bastion at the center of Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this rune?
faq.answer: The rune summons novice rogues to decode its message and report to their trainer. He offers to teach them combat techniques and survival maneuvers.

faq.q: Why does Solm mention the gnomes?
faq.answer: Gnomeregan has recently fallen to disaster, and gnomish refugees share Coldridge Valley and Anvilmar with the dwarves. Solm reminds his students to support them as they settle into their temporary home.

faq.q: Who gives the rune to the player?
faq.answer: Sten Stoutarm gives the stone to rogue adventurers in Coldridge Valley after they help him with local valley matters.

faq.q: Can other classes receive this rune?
faq.answer: No. The rune is for rogue initiates beginning their journeys in Coldridge Valley.

angles.text: As a rogue, the rune brings you to Solm Hargrin. He offers to teach you stealth, martial tricks, and survival skills in Dun Morogh.
As a dwarf of the Ironforge clan, Solm welcomes you into the shadows. A cold blade and darkness help keep you alive in Dun Morogh.
As a gnome, you hear Solm urge his students to stand by the gnomes sheltering in Coldridge Valley after the tragic loss of their home in Gnomeregan.
